description: Mescalero Apache Tribe Adapts to a Warmer and Drier Climate is a case study listed in U.S. Climate Resilience Toolkit, a national climate-adaptation toolkit, published or maintained by Mescalero Apache Tribe; N'de Farms; USFWS, U.S. Fish and Wildlife Service. In the face of a changing climate, the Tribe is building capacity and climate resilience through forestry management, habitat protection, and an approach to healthy eating. Coverage: the United States (2015). The listed link gives the documented application. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the toolkit page (no licence or terms statement seen). Caveats: this record was written from the toolkit page, which was read; the cited source documents and the outcomes reported were not checked, and no model or dataset used was verified. It can support comparison with similar adaptation projects and planning precedents. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-us-climate-resilience-toolkit-catalogue.
